title: Owner cannot drag an Invoiced work order to another technician on Board View
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). Technicians A and B pinned.
A work order for a unique customer, completed, with lead A set while Complete, then invoiced.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is in A's column with a lock whose title reads "The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid."

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the card over B's column without releasing.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The denied pill shows that same text, and no drop indicator shows.
The card stays in A's column, no toast shows and the counts are unchanged.
The card is still in A's column.
